 Filipino movie ‘DoReMi’ marks 30th anniversary
 By Aric John Sy Cua
 November 15, 2026
 110
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 MANILA, Philippines — The movie “DoReMi,” which starred Donna Cruz, Regine Velasquez, and Mikee Cojuangco-Jaworski, has marked its 30th anniversary.
 Known for its song “I Can,” the movie was originally released on Nov. 13, 1996 by Viva Films and directed by Ike Jarlego Jr.
 “When Reg invited Mikee and me once again to surprise her fans at her concerts last Oct. 17–19, we got to sing our songs ‘I Can’ and ‘A Little Love Goes a Long Way’ together… So heartwarming to see how ‘I Can’ continues to inspire generations and has become part of so many celebrations,” Cruz said in an Instagram post.
 DoReMi was a story of three aspiring singers with a strong and lifelong friendship.
 Cojuangco-Jaworski also honored their film in posts on Instagram and Facebook.

 The trio also held a reunion during Velasquez's farewell concert at the MOA Arena in October.
 Velasquez is still active in showbiz, Cruz is currently living with her family in Cebu, while Cojuangco-Jaworski is a member of the International Olympic Committee.
